flashcard_questions.q: The smallest individual unit of a digital image, displayed as a tiny coloured square on screen.
Pixels Per Inch — the number of pixels contained within one inch of an image displayed on a screen.
Dots Per Inch — the number of printed dots contained within one inch of an image produced by a printer.
Which type of image is built from a grid of coloured pixels and pixelates when enlarged?
Which image format is limited to 256 colours but can show simple animation?
